sec-alert-bot: [ALERT] IAM change detected in prod-account (acct-98765). Role 'PowerAdmin' attached to instance profile ip-prod-web-12 at 2026-08-04T15:03:54Z. Possible cross-account PutBucketAcl observed for s3://redwood-prod-backups. Alert ID: A-20260804-983
alex: seeing the alert. which instance/profile? can someone paste the attached policies? @maria
maria: grabbing CLI output now, quick paste:
```bash
$ aws iam list-attached-role-policies --role-name PowerAdmin
AttachedPolicies:
- PolicyName: AdministratorAccess
  PolicyArn: arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
```
oncall-sre: if that's AdministratorAccess on an EC2 instance, treat as compromise and isolate the instance. i'm isolating network now.
oncall-sre: command run: `aws ec2 modify-instance-attribute --instance-id i-0cabc123 --groups sg-000aaaa` -> replaced with isolation security group (no outbound except control plane)
maria: detached the policy from the role and removed the role from the instance profile: `aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name PowerAdmin --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess` and `aws iam remove-role-from-instance-profile --instance-profile-name ip-prod-web-12 --role-name PowerAdmin`
maria: also applied immediate bucket ACL lockdown for backups bucket:
```bash
aws s3api put-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-prod-backups --acl private
aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket redwood-prod-backups --public-access-block-configuration BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
```
nicole: compliance notified, drafting embargoed customer comms. tagging legal/compliance. :lock:
